mentions.name: Vibehuntr
mentions.description: A Yelp alternative web app for browsing venues using Google's API, with a social layer that lets the author see what their friends like. Built as an experiment in vibe coding a full-stack app; described as rough around the edges and likely to change.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a Yelp alternative called Vibehuntr -- just something different to browse venues using Google's API, with a social layer so I can see what my friends like. It's very rough around the edges right now and it might be completely different by next week. It's been a fun experiment in vibe coding on a full stack. https://vibehuntr.io
